headline: MSCI Keeps Indonesia as an Emerging Market, Here Are the August Review Results
summary: MSCI confirmed Indonesia remains an Emerging Market in its 2026 Annual Country Review. A number of stocks were removed from its index in the August review.
why: MSCI is a global index provider whose emerging market classification determines how many funds track Indonesian equities. Index removals can trigger passive fund selling in the affected stocks.
why_moved: MSCI confirmed Indonesia's emerging market status while removing a number of stocks from its index. Removals can prompt passive index funds to sell those shares, and the review affects how foreign funds allocate to Indonesia.
